issue.title: Deduplicate Shard Started Requests

labels.name: :Distributed/Recovery
labels.description: Anything around constructing a new shard, either from a local or a remote source.

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Deduplicate shard started requests the same way we deduplicate shard-failed
and shard snapshot state updates already.

closes #81628

body:
Unfortunately @original-brownbear I don't think #82089 completely fixes this, because we send the response back as soon as the cluster state update is submitted without waiting for it to complete:

https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/212d15ba1e754e80bc2409bdcc5522e19b89cac3/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/cluster/action/shard/ShardStateAction.java#L626-L642

(with thanks to @idegtiarenko for spotting that)
Oh wow, you're right. Easy fix by moving the resolving of the listener to after the CS state update is through I guess. Will implement this in a bit. Thanks for catching!
